title: "2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election Results"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

## Load and Clean Data

```{r}
#| label: clean-data
# Read the county-level election results
county_data <- read_csv("data/20221108__fl__general__county.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter for the Governor race and calculate vote margins
gov_results <- county_data |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party %in% c("REP", "DEM")) |>
  select(county, party, votes) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = party, values_from = votes) |>
  mutate(
    total = REP + DEM,
    rep_margin = (REP - DEM) / total * 100,
    clean_county = str_to_lower(str_remove_all(county, "[^a-zA-Z]"))
  )

# Get Florida county geographic boundaries and join election results
fl_map <- map_data("county", "florida") |>
  mutate(clean_county = str_to_lower(str_remove_all(subregion, "[^a-zA-Z]"))) |>
  left_join(gov_results, by = "clean_county")
```

## Florida Governor Election Map

```{r}
#| label: plot-map
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(fl_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = rep_margin)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Margin",
    labels = \(x) ifelse(x > 0, paste0("+", round(x), "% R"), paste0("+", round(abs(x)), "% D"))
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election Results by County",
    subtitle = "Vote margin between Ron DeSantis (R) and Charlie Crist (D)",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "gray50", hjust = 0.9),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
